entries.title: Job 4:1
segments: ¶And Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 4:2
segments: If a word were essayed to thee, wouldest thou be grieved? But who can refrain from speaking?

entries.title: Job 4:3
segments: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands;

entries.title: Job 4:4
segments: Thy words have upholden him that was stumbling, and thou hast braced up the bending knees:

entries.title: Job 4:5
segments: But now it is come upon thee, and thou grievest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

entries.title: Job 4:6
segments: Hath not thy piety been thy confidence, and the perfection of thy ways thy hope?

entries.title: Job 4:7
segments: ¶Remember, I pray thee, who that was innocent has perished? and where were the upright cut off?

entries.title: Job 4:8
segments: Even as I have seen, they that plough iniquity and sow mischief, reap the same.

entries.title: Job 4:9
segments: By the breath of +God they perish, and by the blast of his nostrils are they consumed.

entries.title: Job 4:10
segments: The roar of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken;

entries.title: Job 4:11
segments: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the whelps of the lioness are scattered.

entries.title: Job 4:12
segments: ¶Now to me a word was secretly brought, and mine ear received a whisper thereof.

entries.title: Job 4:13
segments: In thoughts from visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men: --

entries.title: Job 4:14
segments: Fear came on me, and trembling, and made all my bones to shake;

entries.title: Job 4:15
segments: And a spirit passed before my face--the hair of my flesh stood up--

entries.title: Job 4:16
segments: It stood still; I could not discern the appearance thereof: a form was before mine eyes; I heard a slight murmur and a voice:

entries.title: Job 4:17
segments: Shall [mortal] man be more just than +God? Shall a man be purer than his Maker?

entries.title: Job 4:18
segments: Lo, he trusteth not his servants, and his angels he chargeth with folly:

entries.title: Job 4:19
segments: How much more them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed as the moth!

entries.title: Job 4:20
segments: From morning to evening are they smitten: without any heeding it, they perish for ever.

entries.title: Job 4:21
segments: Is not their tent-cord torn away in them? they die, and without wisdom.
